sentiment.summary: Strategy's fresh news is mildly negative: its October 26 SEC filing showed it bought no Bitcoin in the week of October 19-25, breaking a five-week buying streak, and instead spent $204.9 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares. Holdings stayed at 848,517 BTC (average cost $75,446) while Bitcoin slipped toward $80,000, and MSTR fell 2.2% in Monday premarket and 6.9% last week. The STRC buyback and $5.1 billion in USD assets offer some support, but the paused accumulation plus an MSCI index-exclusion overhang keeps the tone slightly bearish.
